entities.name: Penteli Monastery
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Holy Monastery of the Dormition of the Theotokos is a men's monastery, which today belongs to the Archbishopric of Athens. It is located on the southern side of Mount Penteli, and is therefore also known as the Penteli Monastery.
